Disappointed-don’t celebrate your birthday here
Feb 2026 • Couples
This was my 3rd Valentine’s Birthday celebration at The Grill in 6 years and this time was by far the worst. Even if it wasn’t my birthday the service was terrible. Waiters looking around but not noticing empty water glasses. Our own waiter paying too much attention looking down at his phone than looking up at the table to see us waving at him for service. It was my birthday and there was not a single staff who acknowledged it. They forgot to bring my wine order (a single glass of a Cabernet Shiraz) and I had to l repeat my order to a different waiter. In addition we had to wait 10’minutes for our waiter to return to ask us what our dessert order was (the dessert selection is at most 4-6 items and didn’t take long to choose). And this is the first time out of three we celebrated that there was no birthday cake or candle presented. Even my Marriott Bonvoy app wished me a Happy Birthday when I opened the app to pay for the meal. The waiter checking his phone should be disciplined. For the prices charged the service should not have been so poor. Service Manager needs to be spoken to. Lifetime Gold Bonvoy member with more than 500+ stays and this was hands down the worst
